newsitem.title: UK: MIDSHIRES TO END TIED-AGENCY DEAL WITH SUN.
newsitem.headline: MIDSHIRES TO END TIED-AGENCY DEAL WITH SUN.

text.p: Sun Life & Provincial Holdings Plc said on Wednesday that the Birmingham Midshires Building Society had given 12 months' notice of its intention to end its existing appointed representative agreement with Sun Life.

The move to end the tied-agency agreements follows the announcement earlier by the Royal Bank of Scotland Plc that it was buying Birmingham Midshires, one of Britain's biggest building societies, for 605-630 million pounds.

Sun Life said its new business index (NBI) from the relationship represented about five percent of its total NBI. This is around 3.75 percent of the combined NBI of Sun Life and Axa Equity & Law, which merged in July.
Sun Life, which is Britain's third largest insurance company, had total single premiums of 697.5 million stg for the first half of the year and new regular premiums of 77.0 million.
